transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I’ve been taking on way too many projects at once and can’t seem to slow myself down at work or at home. It feels like I'm constantly in overdrive, and my family and manager really urged me to come in and get some help.

Have you also been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or irritable, with much less need for sleep than usual? Have you had any risky behavior, racing thoughts, or felt more talkative or confident than normal?

Yes, absolutely—I’ve been sleeping very little to keep up, swinging between feeling like a visionary who can reinvent our corporate culture and snapping at my team with intense anger. I'm also talking nonstop because my thoughts are racing, and I've made some really risky decisions like putting expensive event bookings on my personal credit card and firing off unapproved proposals to executives.
Have you ever had a past episode like this before, or any periods of depression that lasted at least two weeks?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before in my life. I haven't had any periods of depression either, so this whole situation is completely new to me.
How long has this elevated, irritable, and overactive period been going on continuously?
It has been going on continuously for about a month now. It really started ramping up and getting out of hand right around the time the big restructuring project at work took off.
Have you been using any substances, such as stimulants, cocaine, cannabis, steroids, or antidepressants, or had any medical illness that could explain these symptoms?
No, I haven't been using any drugs, stimulants, or other medications at all. I also don't have any medical conditions or physical illnesses that could explain why I've been feeling this way.

Have you had any symptoms like hearing or seeing things other people don’t, or feeling unusually certain that you have special powers, a special mission, or that others are trying to harm or control you?

No, I definitely haven't heard or seen things that aren't there, and I don't feel like I have supernatural powers or that anyone is out to get me. My main issue is just feeling incredibly sped up and overcommitted.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a first lifetime episode of abnormally elevated/irritable mood with increased energy, decreased need for sleep, pressured nonstop speech, racing thoughts, distractibility/overcommitment, and risky behavior lasting about one month, causing clear occupational and family concern. No psychotic symptoms, substance use, medical cause, or prior depressive episodes were identified. The presentation is most consistent with a manic episode.
